digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
propositions: Dual vocabulary (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria) pooled in reviewer prompts creates false semantic distinction where only one bar is applied, introducing noise into LLM rubrics and the generated criteria guide.

Textual substitution must consolidate all occurrences of 'success/acceptance criteria' to 'acceptance criteria' across 10 prompt files and the routing index, with explicit manual handling of bare SC tokens in plan_review_G3.md.
The generated criteria guide must be regenerated from the updated prompts and routing index to reflect the consolidated vocabulary throughout all 11 downstream references.
Renaming must explicitly preserve 'success criteria' in plan_review_T2.md (generic English for experiment trial metrics) and dod_uncertifiable wording in verifier prompts, which are out of scope.

Routing index edits rotate the regver stamp, invalidating outstanding attestations as stale; this is safe only because prerequisite ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e (ADR 0053 grandfathering) has already merged.
Registry version must differ measurably before and after the routing edit, captured and asserted at runtime, proving the rotation without hardcoding literal stamps.
